title: 第5章 有义兵张三第6章 徐荣的实力
content_zh:
第五章 有义兵张三
秦岚绝对不是那种随意可以受辱的人，他信奉的哲学是，人敬我一尺，我还你一丈。人欺我一寸，我灭你满门。
所以，在穿越之前的热血三国游戏里，他手中名将无数，却没有人敢抢，以前抢过他名将的人，最后全都不得不退出游戏……没办法不退出，所有的城池全部被人一遍遍的凌辱抢占，一次次的东方再起，再神经大条的人都受不了。玩游戏的，是上来图个痛快，不是来找虐。
所以，秦岚跳起来之后，立刻就抓住那个踢他的家丁，一拳头挥了出去。
那个家伙显然没有想到会被打，所以呆愣愣的被秦岚一拳头打在了脸上。不过，秦岚的这个身体实在太差了，加上之前又有伤，所以一拳头之后，他就已经气喘吁吁。
反而是两个家丁全愣住了。
秦大少爷，出生这十六年何时有过如此勇气？？打人？？看到别人打人，他都吓得直哆嗦。被打的那个，倒是一点都不痛，一个十六岁的发育不健全的孩子打他能有多痛？他在足足愣了十秒之后才反应过来，接着暴怒，我竟然被这个废物打了？？天啊，明天，不，今天晚上我就会成为全府的笑柄！！芳芳肯定也不会再理我！！！
秦岚正双手杵在膝盖上，弯腰喘气，突然，生硬的女声响起，“警报，警报，有敌意目标出现，请尽快做好防御。”
？？？？？
秦岚抬起头，正好看到被自己打的家丁一脸狞笑的向自己抓来，他连忙后退几步，躲了开去。两个家丁顿时交换了一下诧异的眼神，不对啊，这个傻子少爷今天的表现很怪异，不但会打人，还会躲了？？
秦岚却已经没有没有功夫理他，因为顺着他的视线，他面前的WINDOWS光幕上的空白地，出现了两个资料面板，就跟热血三国之中的将领面板一模一样。
土毕，等级3，统率0，体力61，精力35，内政3，勇武28，智谋7，魅力4，运气17，忠诚4，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能无，（秦府家仆，没有什么能力。）。
华力干，等级2，统率0，体力58，精力32，内政5，勇武25，智谋2，魅力6，运气21，忠诚2，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能无，（秦府家仆，没有什么能力）。
！！！！
这是两个家仆的属性？？？我怎么突然可以看到他们的这种资料？？？等等，君主真眼术？？
秦岚差点跳了起来，我擦，游戏中的技能在现实中也可以使用？？？如果是这样，那他岂不是非常强大？？对了，不是还有一个召唤术么，在那里使用？？秦岚按捺着心中的激动，完全无视两个家仆的逼近，开始在面前的光幕上寻找……他已经发觉了，别人根本都看不到这个光幕。
果然，光幕的左上角多了一个箭头符号，秦岚点开它时，顿时光幕最上角弹出一条横幅，写着秦岚，等级1，统率10，体力8/10，精力10/10，内政10，勇武10，智谋10，魅力10，运气10，忠诚－－，职位君主，官职无，爵位无，技能，君主真眼术（默认）。
技能后方还有一个下拉符号，点开来，秦岚的三个技能名称都显示在上面，手指指在君主召唤术上的时候，旁边就再次弹出解释框，（主动技能，能够迅速的把所属的宝物或者从属召唤到自己身边，需要耗费体力和精力，属性值越高的召唤单位，耗费的体力值和精力值越高。目前没有设定快捷方式，请点击使用。）
光幕上顿时再次弹出一列召唤窗口，里面列出了秦岚可以召唤的所有单位。
民夫，等级1，统率0，体力40，精力20，内政10，勇武30，智谋2，魅力5，运气5，士气50，忠诚70，职位无，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力3点，精力3点。（运输物资的民夫，能在承受较大负重的情况下跟随军队行动，几乎没有战斗能力。）

义兵，等级1，统率0，体力60，精力30，内政10，勇武50，智谋8，魅力8，运气8，士气50，忠诚70，职位无，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力5点，精力5点。（临时征召的士兵，只经过简单的训练，战斗力较弱。花费低廉，可以短时间内大批征召。）
斥候，等级1，统率0，体力80，精力50，内政2，勇武10，智谋5，魅力15，运气15，士气50，忠诚70，职位无，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力2点,精力2点。（斥候经过专门的侦察训练，速度非常快，能够潜入敌人城池获得情报。同时派遣多名斥候能获得更详细的情报。）
黄卡夏侯渊，等级1，统率35，体力100，精力100，内政51，勇武87，智谋68，魅力30，运气26，忠诚100，职位主将，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力184点,精力184点。
黄卡田丰，等级1，统率21，体力100，精力100，内政83，勇武27，智谋88，魅力52，运气21，忠诚100，职位城守，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力114点,精力114点。
蓝卡徐荣，等级1，统率10，体力100，精力100，内政33，勇65，智谋42，魅力15，运气15，忠诚100，职位无，官职无，爵位无。召唤需要体力57点,精力57点。
叫做土毕和华力干的两个家仆莫名其妙，这个傻子少爷突然伸出手在空中点啊点的，这是在干什么？？？当然，这个跟他们没关系，土毕狠狠的一巴掌就朝秦岚的脸上扇去，“傻子，你今天竟然敢打我，看来非要好好的教训你一下，让你长点记性！”
“哼！”秦岚却再次后退了几步，现在已经没有的选择，所以他召唤了义兵。
两个恶仆见到秦岚躲开，他们嘿嘿一笑，躲？你能躲到哪里去？？正要继续上前，却突然在他们跟秦岚的中间，从天而降一道白色的光芒，下一刻，一个穿着白色民夫装，扛着农用插具的义兵，出现在了两人眼前。
民夫先是打量了他们一眼，然后一转身看到了秦岚，立刻慌张的放下武器，恭敬的双膝着地跪下，“小的张三，见过大人。”
“张三，这两个家仆打算冒犯我，你帮我教训他们一顿。”秦岚伸手指着对面的两个恶仆，给张三下达了命令。啊
“是，大人，这件事就包在小的身上！！”
content_en:
Chapter 5 There is a volunteer named Zhang San
Qin Lan is definitely not the kind of person who can be humiliated at will. The philosophy he believes in is that if anyone respects me, I will return the same to you. If someone bullies me even an inch, I will destroy your whole family.
Therefore, in the game of the Three Kingdoms before the time travel, he had numerous famous generals, but no one dared to steal them. People who had snatched his famous generals in the past had to quit the game in the end... There was no way not to quit. All the cities were humiliated and occupied over and over again. Even the most arrogant person could not stand it. People who play games are here to have fun, not to be tortured.
Therefore, after Qin Lan jumped up, he immediately grabbed the servant who kicked him and punched him out.
The guy obviously didn't expect to be beaten, so he was punched in the face by Qin Lan. However, Qin Lan's health was really bad, and he had been injured before, so after one punch, he was already out of breath.
Instead, the two servants were stunned.
Young Master Qin, when have you ever had such courage in the sixteen years since you were born? ? Hit someone? ? He trembled with fear when he saw others beating others. The one who was beaten didn't feel any pain at all. How painful could it be for a sixteen-year-old child with developmental disabilities to hit him? He was stunned for ten seconds before he reacted, and then became furious, I was beaten by this loser? ? Oh my God, tomorrow, no, tonight I will be the laughing stock of the whole house! ! Fangfang will definitely never pay attention to me again! ! !
Qin Lan was placing her hands on her knees, bending down to catch her breath. Suddenly, a stiff female voice sounded, "Alarm, alarm, a hostile target has appeared. Please prepare your defense as soon as possible."
? ? ? ? ?
Qin Lan raised his head and saw the servant he had beaten grabbing towards him with a grin on his face. He quickly took a few steps back and dodged away. The two servants immediately exchanged surprised looks. No, this idiot young master behaved very strangely today. He not only beat people, but also hid? ?
Qin Lan had no time to pay attention to him, because following his line of sight, two information panels appeared on the blank space on the WINDOWS screen in front of him, which were exactly the same as the general panels in the Three Kingdoms.
Tubi, level 3, command 0, physical strength 61, energy 35, internal affairs 3, bravery 28, resourcefulness 7, charm 4, luck 17, loyalty 4, no position, no official position, no title, no skills, (Qin Mansion servant has no ability.).
Huali Gan, level 2, command 0, physical strength 58, energy 32, internal affairs 5, bravery 25, resourcefulness 2, charm 6, luck 21, loyalty 2, no position, no official position, no title, no skills, (Qin Mansion servant, no ability).
! ! ! !
Is this the attribute of two domestic servants? ? ? How come I can suddenly see this kind of information about them? ? ? Wait, the monarch’s true eye technique? ?
Qin Lan almost jumped up. Damn it, the skills in the game can also be used in reality? ? ? If so, wouldn't he be very powerful? ? By the way, isn't there another summoning spell? Where can I use it? ? Qin Lan suppressed the excitement in his heart, completely ignored the approach of the two servants, and began to search on the light screen in front of him... He had already realized that no one else could see this light screen at all.
Sure enough, there was an arrow symbol in the upper left corner of the light screen. When Qin Lan clicked on it, a banner popped up in the top corner of the light screen, which read Qin Lan, level 1, command 10, physical strength 8/10, energy 10/10, internal affairs 10, bravery 10, resourcefulness 10, charm 10, luck 10, loyalty--, position monarch, no official position, no title, skills, monarch's true eye (default).
There is a drop-down symbol behind the skill. When you click it, Qin Lan's three skill names are displayed on it. When you point your finger on the Monarch Summoning Technique, an explanation box pops up next to it again. (Active skill can quickly transfer the belonging treasure or subordinateSummoning to your side requires stamina and energy. The higher the attribute value of the summoned unit, the higher the stamina and energy it consumes. There is currently no shortcut set, please click to use it. )
A summoning window suddenly popped up on the light screen again, which listed all the units that Qin Lan could summon.
Civilian husband, level 1, command 0, physical strength 40, energy 20, internal affairs 10, bravery 30, resourcefulness 2, charm 5, luck 5, morale 50, loyalty 70, no position, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 3 points of physical strength and 3 points of energy. (Civilians who transport supplies can follow the army while bearing a heavy load and have almost no combat capability.)
Volunteer, level 1, command 0, physical strength 60, energy 30, internal affairs 10, bravery 50, resourcefulness 8, charm 8, luck 8, morale 50, loyalty 70, no position, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 5 points of physical strength and 5 points of energy. (Temporarily recruited soldiers only undergo simple training and have weak combat effectiveness. The cost is low and they can be recruited in large numbers in a short period of time.)
Scout, level 1, command 0, physical strength 80, energy 50, internal affairs 2, bravery 10, resourcefulness 5, charm 15, luck 15, morale 50, loyalty 70, no position, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 2 points of physical strength and 2 points of energy. (Scouts have undergone special reconnaissance training and are very fast. They can sneak into enemy cities to obtain intelligence. Sending multiple scouts at the same time can obtain more detailed intelligence.)
Huangka Xia Houyuan, level 1, command 35, physical strength 100, energy 100, internal affairs 51, bravery 87, resourcefulness 68, charm 30, luck 26, loyalty 100, position as chief general, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 184 physical points and 184 energy points.
Huangka Tianfeng, level 1, command 21, physical strength 100, energy 100, internal affairs 83, bravery 27, resourcefulness 88, charm 52, luck 21, loyalty 100, position city guard, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 114 physical points and 114 energy points.
Blue card Xu Rong, level 1, command 10, physical strength 100, energy 100, internal affairs 33, courage 65, resourcefulness 42, charm 15, luck 15, loyalty 100, no position, no official position, no title. Summoning requires 57 physical points and 57 energy points.
The two servants named Tubi and Hualigan were confused. This idiot young master suddenly stretched out his hand and clicked in the air. What was he doing? ? ? Of course, this has nothing to do with them. Tubi slapped Qin Lan hard on the face, "Idiot, you dare to hit me today. It seems that I have to teach you a lesson so that you can remember it better!"
"Hmph!" Qin Lan took a few steps back again. Now he had no choice, so he summoned the rebels.
When the two evil servants saw Qin Lan running away, they laughed, hiding? Where can you hide? ? Just as they were about to move forward, a white light suddenly fell from the sky between them and Qin Lan. The next moment, a volunteer soldier wearing a white civilian uniform and carrying a farm implement appeared in front of them.
The civilian husband looked at them first, then turned around and saw Qin Lan. He immediately put down his weapon in a panic and knelt down on the ground respectfully, "Little Zhang San, I have met your lord."
"Zhang San, these two servants are trying to offend me, please help me teach them a lesson." Qin Lan pointed at the two evil servants opposite and gave Zhang San an order. Ah
"Yes, sir, this matter will be taken care of by the little one!!"
